BrochureContent.Content:
Welcome to No. 25 Caddell, The Links, Portmarnock, a beautifully presented and exceptionally spacious two-bedroom first-floor apartment, ideally positioned within one of Portmarnock's most desirable residential developments. Presented in true walk-in condition this property is a perfect fit for first time buyers and downsizers alike.

The bright and spacious accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall, family bathroom, kitchen, open plan dining and living area which is beautifully enhanced by a feature bay window that floods the space with natural light. There are two generously proportioned double bedrooms including a spacious master bedroom with en-suite, while a private south-facing balcony provides the perfect outdoor space to enjoy all-day sunshine.

The Links is a modern, beautifully maintained development ideally located just moments from the stunning Velvet Strand, Portmarnock Beach and the picturesque coastal walkway. Residents enjoy easy access to a host of local amenities including cafés, restaurants, shops, schools, sports clubs and excellent transport links with both Portmarnock DART Station and Dublin Bus services nearby, providing swift access to Dublin City Centre and beyond. The nearby M1, M50 and Dublin Airport are also within easy reach, making this an exceptionally convenient and highly sought-after location...
